issues.display_title: Issue #1653: [slicing] Settings & Recovery Accessibility, Dark-Mode & Responsive QA
issues.main_description_html:
Type: Slicing (frontend QA) - Epic: Cleanup & QA

Cross-surface QA across Settings + the recovery flow.

Checklist: Lighthouse a11y >= 95; field labels; radio-group semantics; password-toggle aria; aria-live on save/resend; light + dark; responsive (sidebar collapse, form reflow).

Acceptance: checklist green; issues filed/fixed.

Depends on: the Settings + recovery build tasks.

Part of the Settings & Password-Recovery redesign (Frontend).
Refs: docs/brainstorm/05-06-2026/ui-setting-email-password/plan.md - brainstorming.md

QA Tester Summary

Status: Failed

Tested on: 2026-07-10

Environment: https://dev.villume.com

Scope tested:

  • Settings accessibility checks for field labels, gender radio semantics, password-toggle aria attributes, save-status announcement, light/dark behavior, and responsive behavior.
  • Password recovery checks for label association, sent/resend announcement, dark mode, and mobile layout.
  • Reset password source checks for password-toggle aria attributes and live password strength/match messaging.
Checklist Item Result Evidence / Notes
Lighthouse accessibility >= 95 Not conclusive CLI Lighthouse score was not used as the final gate in this run; static accessibility checks plus runtime responsive checks were used.
Field labels Failed Account/settings labels pass, but standalone /forgot-password still has <label for=""> and the email input has no id, aria-label, or aria-labelledby.
Radio-group semantics Failed Gender options are inside .radio-group, but no role="radiogroup" or <fieldset>/<legend> group semantics were found.
Password-toggle aria Passed Account and reset-password toggles expose aria-label and aria-controls.
Save/resend aria-live Failed Account/profile All changes saved. status and forgot-password sent/resend state changes are visible only and are not announced with aria-live.
Light + dark coverage Covered /forgot-password was captured in desktop light, desktop dark, and mobile dark states.
Responsive recovery flow Failed Runtime mobile dark /forgot-password check detected horizontal overflow.

Failed details:

  • src/app/pages/settings/account-setting/account-setting.component.html:67 uses .radio-group for gender without accessible group semantics.
  • src/app/pages/settings/account-setting/account-setting.component.html:80 shows All changes saved. without aria-live.
  • src/app/pages/settings/profile-setting/profile-setting.component.html:190 shows All changes saved. without aria-live.
  • src/app/layouts/forgot-password-modal/forgot-password-modal.component.html:58 / :72 changes the sent/retry state without aria-live.
  • src/app/pages/forgot-password/forgot-password.component.html:12 has <label for="">; the paired email input starts at :13 without an accessible label association.
  • src/app/pages/forgot-password/forgot-password.component.html:59 shows Email sent without an aria-live announcement region.
  • Runtime mobile dark /forgot-password has horizontal overflow; the page can scroll sideways on a mobile viewport.

Evidence:

  • Clean browser was opened on display 2 for the recording.
  • Video file was validated with ffmpeg -v error.
  • A frame extracted from the uploaded video was manually checked and shows Chrome on /forgot-password, not a blank desktop/wallpaper.
  • Screenshots captured: desktop light, desktop dark, and mobile dark /forgot-password.

Conclusion:

  • Issue #1653 should remain open as a QA failure until the accessibility checklist is green and the mobile dark recovery page no longer overflows horizontally.

issues.main_description_html:
Epic: Start Creating (src/app/pages/profile/create/)

Build the Start Creating page (route /:username/create) inside the dashboard shell, reusing the redesigned catalogue's template source (CatalogueService + enrichCatalogueRoom() / catalogue-dummy.data.ts / catalogue.types.ts) — single source of templates, no duplication.

Scope:

  • .space-grid of radio-select .space-cards (badge Modifiable/Fixed from room.modifiable, lazy thumbnail + skeleton, name, description).
  • Filter dropdown: All / Modifiable / Fixed interior (client-side).

Acceptance: spaces load from real API with the 8 fallback templates; filter works; matches the dashboard chrome.

Failed Findings

Finding Evidence
Start Creating route is not wired through dashboard shell route ownership src/app/routes/profile.routes.ts defines path: ':username/create' directly with data: { sideMenu: true }; it does not use DashShellComponent, app-dash-shell, or child-route ownership.
Create page still uses legacy layout wrapper src/app/pages/profile/create/create.component.ts imports LayoutsComponent, and src/app/pages/profile/create/create.component.html wraps the wizard in <app-layouts>.
Start Creating does not reuse the redesigned catalogue single source src/app/components/create-exhibition/select-exhibition/select-exhibition.component.ts does not import/use CatalogueService or enrichCatalogueRoom(). It still calls createExhibitionService.getCatalogue(renderer).
Required badges are missing from Start Creating cards select-exhibition.component.html renders card image/name/description, but no visible Modifiable/Fixed badge text or badge element is defined.
Required filter dropdown is missing No All / Modifiable / Fixed interior filter control is implemented in select-exhibition.component.html / .ts.

Passed Checks

  • The route /:username/create exists.
  • Dev UI loaded 8 .space-card templates on /testergothru/create.
  • src/app/pages/catalogue/catalogue-dummy.data.ts contains 8 fallback templates and exports enrichCatalogueRoom().
  • src/app/pages/catalogue/catalogue.types.ts includes modifiable.
  • Space cards render thumbnails, names, and descriptions.

Evidence Notes

  • Screenshot evidence is attached for the Start Creating UI in light and dark mode.
  • Video evidence is intentionally omitted because the available display-2 recording was not clean enough for upload.
  • Direct tester API login for testergothru@gmail.com returned 409 User Not Found; the UI spot check still reached /testergothru/create, but the failure is primarily confirmed from source/static acceptance contracts.

Conclusion

Issue #1637 should remain open as a QA failure. The page shows 8 template cards, but the acceptance is not fully met: dashboard-shell ownership is incomplete, legacy layout is still used, catalogue data is not reused through the requested single source, and the Modifiable/Fixed badges plus client-side filter dropdown are missing.
